title: JJK – Central 47 Database Terminal
description: Jujutsu Sorcery Commission classified network terminal. Opens from the Journal sidebar — available to all players and the GM for in-session roleplay access.
description-changes: v3.0.2 — Sync delivery hardening. The terminal asset URL is now version-busted so player browsers / CDNs can never serve a stale pre-sync terminal (the root cause of 'players see no posts'); the terminal re-sends its hydration handshake until the module answers; the module re-pushes the authoritative board after the terminal loads; the GM client self-heals a missing Forum State journal; and the terminal header now shows a SYNC lamp (green LINKED / amber WAIT) so link problems are visible at a glance.
